tour.replayDesc: Watch the guided bubbles again on every screen.

intro.b: This is your career hub. Here is a quick tour of the interface; you can skip it at any time.

tabs.b: Everything lives in these tabs: racing, progression, money and your story. Each one shows its own short guide the first time you open it.

credits.b: Your money. You earn it racing and from sponsors, and spend it on entry fees, cars and skins.

rep.b: Your Rating. It rises when you beat good drivers, and opens doors to better teams and series.

win.b: Minimize the app, switch to windowed mode or close it. The app steps aside on its own when a race launches.

intro.b: Your career at a glance. Check it after each race to see where you stand.

card.b: Who you are: identity, fame and trophies.

glance.b: The key numbers of your season.

events.b: Limited time races with their own rewards. Enter them from here.

intro.b: The master calendar. Pick a round, pay the entry fee and go racing. Time only moves forward.

filters.b: Narrow the list by availability, era or discipline.

advance.b: Time runs day by day until something worth stopping for. Set what stops it and see what you would cross before you commit.

list.b: Races grouped by day. Green means you can enter; a lock tells you what you are missing.

intro.b: The road from rookie to the apex, discipline by discipline.

ladder.b: Your current level. Superlicences unlock the next step.

matrix.b: Every series in the game, sorted by discipline and level. Locked ones show what they require.

intro.b: The seasons you are enrolled in and the ones you could join.

detail.b: Points, rivals and your position in the selected championship.

intro.b: Every race you have run, with the full grid and lap times.

list.b: Pick a race to open its full result.

intro.b: Who drives where, and until when. Seats only come into play during the transfer window; the decision week settles them all at once.
Teams make offers here. Better REP brings better offers.

rep.b: What teams see when they look at you.

offers.b: Some teams seek you out, others accept applications. A tryout race can earn you the seat.

intro.b: Sponsor cards pay you for results. You win new cards after podium finishes.

slots.b: Cards placed here are live and pay out. Slots unlock as you progress.

manage.b: Select a card to read its terms, activate it or discard it.

intro.b: The historic eras of motorsport. You get into one when you own its car. Your first, a 1967 F1, is a gift after your third race.

rail.b: Eras you own are ready to race. The rest show the car you need to buy to get in, and its price.

detail.b: Buy the car once and the whole era opens up. Watch the rotating events: they put these cars on discount.

intro.b: Your full record as a driver.

hero.b: Your Rating as a number. It rises and falls with your results against other drivers.

arc.b: Your story so far, season by season.

intro.b: Mail from Atenea, your manager, plus offers and notices. The badge on the tab tells you when something new arrives.

list.b: Select a message to read it.

intro.b: The cars you own. Team seats lend you their car; owning one lets you enter races on your own.

grid.b: Everything you have bought, with its class and value.

intro.b: Liveries for your cars: the ones you own and packs you can install.

drop.b: Drop a livery pack here to install it into the game.

grid.b: Browse and buy liveries; your car wears the one you pick.

intro.b: Difficulty, app preferences, profiles and your account.

difficulty.b: How strong the AI is. The adaptive mode tunes it to your pace.

gameplay.b: How each race gets configured: realism multipliers, the safety car, and Auto or Inherited per field.

replay.b: Run this guide again whenever you want from this button.

intro.b: Last stop before the track: pick your car and check the costs.

cars.b: Cars you can race today: your own or your team's.

duration.b: Shorter races pay less but cost less time. Some contracts fix the length.

actions.b: This fires the race in AMS2 and the app steps aside. Drive, finish, and the result comes back here.

intro.b: The race is settled: position, money and what it did to your career.

hero.b: Where you ended up and how the money adds up.

progress.b: REP, XP and ladder movement earned in this race.

intro.b: A podium earns you a visit to the shop: new sponsor cards to choose from.

cards.b: Pick the card that fits your plans; check its terms first.

actions.b: Not convinced? Reroll the offer for credits, or continue without buying.

intro.b: The year is over. The world moves: drivers retire, rookies arrive, seats change hands.

cols.b: Retirements, promotions and market moves around you.

contract.b: Renew, negotiate or walk away. Pick before confirming.

confirm.b: This closes the season and starts the next one.

bridgeError.title: AMS2 bridge could not start
bridgeError.protectionHistory: Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Protection history and check whether Career Engine was quarantined.
bridgeError.verifyDownload: Reinstall only from the official GitHub release, then verify the release SHA-256.
bridgeError.reportFalsePositive: If it was blocked, submit the file to your security provider as a false positive.

codes.policy_denied: The AMS2 bridge rejected an unsupported launch request.
codes.bridge_unavailable: The AMS2 bridge is unavailable. The installation may be damaged or security software may have quarantined it.
codes.dll_missing: The required Career Engine DLL is missing.
codes.dll_invalid: The Career Engine DLL is invalid or damaged.
codes.dll_identity_mismatch: The Career Engine DLL does not match the installed bridge.
codes.access_denied: Windows denied access while the AMS2 bridge was starting.
codes.launch_prepare_failed: The AMS2 bridge could not prepare the game for the engine.
codes.launch_transfer_failed: The AMS2 bridge could not hand the engine over to the game.
codes.launch_setup_failed: The AMS2 bridge could not complete its own setup.

firstrun.title: Welcome
firstrun.welcomeBody: A living career layer for Automobilista 2. Let's find your game and get you on track.
firstrun.needGraphicsXml: Couldn't find graphicsconfigdx11.xml there. Run the game once, then retry.
firstrun.displayWhy: The app covers the game window in management mode, so AMS2 must run in borderless.
firstrun.displayNeedFix: AMS2 is not in borderless mode.
firstrun.gameRunning: Close AMS2 first so I can edit the display config.
firstrun.newCareerDesc: Create a driver and start from the bottom.
firstrun.importSaveDesc: Bring a career.sav from a previous build.
firstrun.assetsBody: Career Engine generates car photos and track maps from YOUR Automobilista 2 installation. Nothing from the game is redistributed. This takes about 3–6 minutes, temporarily uses up to ~10 GB of disk space while extracting (freed automatically when it finishes) and keeps ~450 MB when done. You can skip it — the app works with placeholders and you can generate them later from Settings.
firstrun.assetsDone: Assets ready — {{ok}} images ({{fail}} failed, {{skipped}} already existed)
firstrun.assetsDotnet: The extraction tool needs the .NET Runtime for 64-bit Windows, and it is not installed on this PC. Get it from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download (any current version works, just make sure it says x64) and try again.
firstrun.assetsDisk: Not enough temporary disk space (~10 GB needed during generation).
firstrun.assetsToolCorrupt: The extraction tool that ships with the app (PCarsTools.exe) is damaged, so it cannot start. This usually means an interrupted install or an antivirus that quarantined part of it. Reinstall the app — and if your antivirus flags it, allow the install folder — then try again.

prefs.title: App preferences
prefs.sub: Window & focus behavior of the manager app
prefs.autoSwitchDesc: Bring Automobilista 2 to the front when a race starts, and return the app to the front when it ends. Turn off to manage the window yourself with the controls at the top right.
prefs.launchModeDesc: How the Play button launches Automobilista 2: flat screen or virtual reality. Only applies when the app launches the game; if AMS2 is already running, Play just links to it. 'Choose in Steam' opens Steam's own launch picker — use it to pick AMS2's OpenXR mode (needed by motion-rig compensation tools).
prefs.vrAms2GazeOffHint: Off: AMS2 won't click the menu option you stare at. Use your wheel, controller or keyboard in the game menus. Applied when the game launches.
prefs.vrAms2GazeOnHint: On: staring at an option in the AMS2 menus clicks it. With the app panel in front of you, the game may click whatever is behind it by accident. Applied when the game launches.
prefs.vrOverlayDesc: Show a floating panel with the app inside the headset when you play in VR, with a pointer to click on it. Works the same on SteamVR and on Oculus. It deploys in the menus and retracts while you drive. Takes effect the next time you launch the game.
prefs.vrConfirmKeyDesc: This key acts as the click on the panel, whether you are aiming with your gaze or with a controller. Takes effect the next time you launch the game.
prefs.vrConfirmKeyWarn: Don't pick a key that also confirms in AMS2: both actions would fire at once.
prefs.vrConfirmKeyClash: {{key}} also confirms in AMS2. Pressing it will probably do something besides the click.
prefs.vrConfirmPressAny: Press a key or a wheel/controller button…
prefs.vrConfirmPadUnreadable: The game cannot read the buttons of {{name}}. Press a button on your wheel, button box or an Xbox-compatible controller, or a key.
prefs.vrConfirmButtonFallback: If that device is not connected when the game starts, {{key}} clicks instead.
prefs.vrRuntimeSteamHint: Any headset, OpenComposite included (detected on its own) — recommended
prefs.vrRuntimeDialogHint: Opens Steam's launch picker — OpenXR, motion rigs
prefs.uiScaleDesc: Makes the content bigger inside the same window: text and controls grow, and a little less fits on screen. Handy when the app sits on a far or angled monitor. It applies right away and is remembered. Shortcuts: Ctrl + and Ctrl -, and Ctrl 0 to go back to 100%.
prefs.simRaceDesc: With this on, the race is not launched in the game: the mod fabricates the result in a few seconds (almost always a podium, it can fail) so you can test career progress. Same switch as the one on the connection screen; applies to the next race you launch.
prefs.launchNoticeDesc: Show the hands-off reminder for a few seconds after you press Rent or Race, while we walk the game's menus and write your race into Custom Race. A click of yours lands in that same menu and undoes it. Turn it back on here if you dismissed it with "don't show this again".

content.unscanned: Waiting for the game catalog — launch AMS2 once to detect your content.
content.hint: Auto follows what the app finds in your install. On and Off are your own call and stay put through game updates.
content.notOwnedHint: Steam says this pack is not on your account, so it cannot be turned on. Its circuits are replaced by ones you own.

assets.sub: Car photos and track maps generated from your AMS2 install
assets.desc: Regenerate after an AMS2 update to pick up new cars and tracks. Existing images are kept; only missing ones are created.
assets.done: Done — {{ok}} new images ({{fail}} failed, {{skipped}} already existed)
assets.devNote: Custom data folder in use (dev config) — managed sync is off.
assets.stepExtractVeh: Extracting car photos from the game
assets.stepExtractTrk: Extracting track maps from the game

gamefiles.title: Game files
gamefiles.sub: Your original AMS2 files, preserved by the mod
gamefiles.desc: The career mod writes its own AI grids to UserData\CustomAIDrivers, backing up any file you already had. This restores your originals and removes the mod's files. Close AMS2 first; the mod will rewrite its grids next time you play.
gamefiles.done: Done — {{restored}} of your files restored, {{removed}} mod files removed.
gamefiles.gameRunning: Close Automobilista 2 first — its files are in use while the game runs.
gamefiles.noConfig: No configuration found — complete the first-run wizard first.

wx.title: Weather
wx.sub: What the weather does across a race, and which kinds you want to see.
wx.modeDesc: Random lets the game roll the weather for each session, the way it always did. Inherited leaves whatever you have set in Custom Race. Your picks builds a believable arc for every race, using only the weather you tick below.
wx.pickDesc: Tick the weather that can show up. The session still gets a coherent arc — it just never leaves your selection. You cannot untick every single one.
wx.note: A race with authored weather (a historic wet round, a special event) always keeps it, whichever mode you pick. And the prerace screen never tells you what is coming: the weather is a surprise.

fcy.label: Safety car / Full Course Yellow
fcy.desc: On forces the rule on for every race: a full-course yellow (safety car) can be deployed after an on-track incident. Off forces it off. Inherited leaves the rule alone, so whatever your own Custom Race has set is what runs. Default is On.

closeGame.title: Close AMS2 too?
closeGame.desc: The game is still running. Do you want to close AMS2 along with the app, or leave it open?

support.title: Support
support.logDesc: A single file with everything that happened: races, purchases, difficulty changes, app actions. If something goes wrong, share this file with your report.
support.pre070BackupNote: Before your first 0.7.0 launch, a one-time backup of your careers was saved to {{path}}.
support.pre070BackupFailedNote: The one-time backup of your careers before the 0.7.0 migration could not be completed. Check the support log for details.

profiles.sub: Multiple careers at once: each profile keeps its own save
profiles.careerDesc: Regular career: you start as a rookie with the full onboarding.
profiles.sandboxDesc: Sandbox: everything unlocked from the start plus 10,000,000 CR. No calibration race.
profiles.limitReached: Max {{n}} profiles — delete one to add another.
profiles.restartWarn: The grids were regenerated for this profile. Restart AMS2 to apply them.

shm.warnBody: Without it the mod can't read results or settle your races. Enable it in AMS2: Options → System → Shared Memory = "Project CARS 2", then restart the game.

gamepad.sub: Navigate the app with the D-pad or stick; A to select, B to go back, LB/RB switch tabs

gamepad.noDevices: No device detected yet. Press a button on your controller or wheel with this window in front: the browser does not reveal a device until you do.

race.waitingResult: Waiting for the race to finish…
race.settledBody: Your result is in. Exit the race in Automobilista 2 to get back to the main menu, and it opens here.

simrace.launchedBody: Simulation mode is on: no driving needed. The result will be generated in a few seconds.

lowram.hint: Experimental. Turn ON if AMS2 freezes for a long time (and its RAM shoots up) when you hit Race. It stops the mod from doing a heavy full-memory scan while the race loads. Takes effect next time you launch the game.

why.form: Your recent form won them over.

offerExpiredWhy.season_started: That season has already started. This one got away.
offerExpiredWhy.withdrawn: The team pulled it off the table before you answered.
offerExpiredWhy.window_over: This offer belongs to a transfer window that has already closed.

calib_sub: A measurement race sets your baseline difficulty.
calib_epic_body: Listen. A {{class}} series is touring {{country}} this week, and they've opened the grid to unproven drivers. Chances like this don't come twice — a full field of professionals, one weekend to show what you're made of. Run this and there's a before and after in your career. Don't waste it.
calib_epic_note: This is also your calibration run — we'll read your pace and set your difficulty from it. Afterwards you'll race on Adaptive difficulty by default; you can change it any time in Settings.
calib_seed_hint: We read your pace, not theirs, so this number doesn't change the measurement on its own. Push it too high and you'll spend the race stuck in traffic, your best lap will come out slower than you really are, and we'll set your level too low for everything after. When in doubt, take it easy.

gpscale.title: Auto race multipliers
gpscale.sub: Scale tyre wear and fuel use to each race's length
gpscale.tyreDesc: On: raises tyre wear on shorter races so tyre strategy still matters — full distance stays at x1, shorter ones scale up to x5. Inherited: the mod writes nothing and your own Custom Race setting applies. Either way your global setting is restored after each race.
gpscale.fuelDesc: On: raises fuel usage on shorter races so saving and refuelling still matter — full distance stays at x1, shorter ones scale up to x5. Inherited: the mod writes nothing and your own Custom Race setting applies. Either way your global setting is restored after each race.

aggr.title: AI aggression
aggr.sub: How hard rivals attack and defend
aggr.label: Aggression
aggr.desc: Auto scales with your career phase (the higher you climb, the harder the racing). A fixed value applies to every race; gate qualifiers always run at maximum.

raceSetup.title: Race setup
raceSetup.sub: How each race you launch gets configured
raceSetup.entryDesc: Auto or Inherited per field, auto race multipliers and the safety car, all in one place.

inherit.title: Auto or Inherited
inherit.sub: Per field: Auto = the career sets it for you; Inherited = we leave it alone and your own Custom Race setup applies
inherit.hourDesc: Auto: the event sets the session start time. Inherited: your own start time applies.
inherit.timeProgDesc: Auto: time acceleration follows the race length setup. Inherited: your own time progression applies.
inherit.startDesc: Auto: standing or rolling start per the real series. Inherited: your own start type applies.
inherit.pitDesc: Auto: mandatory stop, refuelling, minimum tyres and pit speed limit per the real series. Inherited: your own pit rules apply.
inherit.aiDesc: Auto: skill, aggression and mistakes come from your Difficulty settings above. Inherited: the AI strength you have set in the game applies. Gate qualifiers still force maximum AI.
inherit.sessionsDesc: Auto: the career sets session lengths (and every race gets qualifying). Inherited: your own weekend structure applies.
inherit.note: Applies to calendar races. The calibration race, contract trials and special events always use their own setup. Inherited means the game keeps whatever that field was last set to in Custom Race.

gate_supl_go: Click to jump to the superlicense test
supl_blocks: Until earned: its calendar rounds stay locked and its market offers stay held.
cal_qualifier_hint: Win this one-off test to earn the superlicense it guards
dlc_sub_note: Runs here instead of {{orig}} — that circuit belongs to {{product}}, which is not on your Steam account.
champ_by_invite_hint: Closed grid — teams hire from the Market. Sign a contract to race here.
tryout_free_note: No cost — the team provides the car. Finish inside the target to earn the seat.
mkt_closed_why: The transfer window opens on 1 September. Until then teams watch but do not sign: what you do on track between now and that date is what they will have in front of them when they sit down to decide.
mkt_empty_why: Seats open up when drivers retire or get promoted at the end of the season — and occasionally mid-season, when the silly season shakes the grid. Keep racing: results raise your rating and teams come to you.
divorce_warn: Switching colours mid-season costs −{{cr}}, settled after the race, and your image with sponsors takes the hit. The new car & livery become your ride.
mkt_apply_free: Applying commits nothing — everything resolves in decision week.
pd_applied_long: You are in the fight for this seat
pd_no_contracts: You are not under contract with anyone.
pd_offered_hint: You may sign more than one — your calendar, your money and exclusivity are the limits.
pd_none_offered: Nothing offered to you this time.
pd_reason_already: You already race in that series.
pd_reason_no_offered: That seat is not on the table.
pd_empty: No seats in play right now.
pd_empty_season: No seats in play — the window opens later in the year.
cal_clash_body: You already have {{series}} that day. Racing this will mark that race as a DNF. Continue?
cal_clash_why: The dates overlap, so racing this will mark the other race as a DNF. Continue?
cal_today_jump: Jump to today in the calendar
cal_jump_date_past: Pick a date in the future, not one that already passed.
pd_char_fiel_marca: They reward loyalty to the brand
pd_char_patriotico: They race under their own flag
pd_char_veterano: They want a safe pair of hands
pd_break_confirm: Pay ₡ {{n}}. {{team}} won't forgive you, and your image with sponsors takes the hit. You lose the seat and there is no going back.
diff_adaptive_d: Your level: the average across your categories. Each one learns on its own, from its own races — hover the number to see them.
diff_by_class_seeded: from the community · not raced yet
diff_locks_sub: Each category learns its own number from your races. The lock freezes it where it is.
diff_locks_level_note: Average of your {{n}} raced categories. A category you try for the first time starts at this level.
diff_locks_trim_note: Your manual trim {{trim}} applies on top, and the lock does not freeze it.
diff_locks_all_seeded: None of your categories has a number of its own yet: they all follow your level, so there is nothing of theirs to freeze and their padlocks are off. Race one and its padlock turns on. "Lock all" does cover them meanwhile.
diff_locks_foot: The lock freezes what the mode learns. Your races still count, the manual trim still applies, and the category still counts toward your level.
diff_lock_all_note: With this on, a category you try for the first time will start at your level and will not adjust.
diff_lock_seeded: You have not raced this category yet. Its number still comes from your level, so there is nothing of its own to lock — race it once, or use Lock all.
diff_locks_empty: You have not raced any category on adaptive yet. The master lock still works: it will apply to the first one you try.
launch_notice_gaze: In the headset, try not to rest your eyes on one spot: Automobilista 2 fires the pointer where you look if you hold still long enough, and that counts as a click on whatever is under it.
launch_notice_alttab: Don't Alt+Tab by hand either. The app steps aside on its own and comes back when the race is over.
launch_notice_hands: Don't touch the mouse, keyboard or wheel until you see ALL SET on screen. One click of yours lands in the same menu and undoes what we just wrote.
launch_notice_why: We're about to walk through Automobilista 2's menus and write your race into Custom Race. The game can't tell our clicks from yours while that happens, so give us a few seconds.
launch_notice_title: Hands off for a few seconds

telemetry.title: Share race data
telemetry.why: The AI difficulty of each class and track is tuned with real races. If you share yours, those numbers get better for everyone and ship in the next update.

sent.class: The class, track, date and series of the race.
sent.config: How it was launched: length, weather, pit rules, wear, AI difficulty.
sent.result: The result: your position, whether you finished, and the best lap of every car on the grid.
sent.answer: Your answer to the question after the race, if you answer it.

telemetry.notSent: No name, no email, no driver identity, nothing about your PC or your files. Only an anonymous id so the same game is not counted twice.
telemetry.changeLater: You can change this whenever you want in Settings.
telemetry.settingsDesc: Class, track, launch settings, result and lap times of each race. Never your name or anything about your PC.

grids.staleTitle: The grids on track are out of date
grids.staleBody: Drivers have changed seats since AMS2 started. The game only reads the grids when it launches, so restart it to race against the new line-ups.
grids.staleIgnoreWhy: Ignore this and you keep racing the grids AMS2 loaded when it started: the new line-ups stay off track until you restart it yourself.

assetsStale.title: Automobilista 2 has been updated
assetsStale.body: Your car photos and track maps were generated with build {{old}}, and the game is now on {{new}}. Updates sometimes add cars or tracks; if this one did, they'll show without a photo or map until you regenerate them.
assetsStale.cost: Regenerating extracts around 9.5 GB from the game and takes a while.
